positions.title: The Siemens Graduate Program (SGP) is the personalized career path for high potential graduates that runs over two years and gives its participants three challenging assignments nationally as well as internationally.
positions.description: Kick-start your career wth three challenges spread across two exciting years.

positions.title: Head of Surgery, Asia Pacific Region
positions.description:
Headed Business and Marketing for the Surgery Business Line in Asia Pacific, with responsibilities including:
- Developing the market for Hybrid Operating Rooms, Angio-CT, Angio-MR, and Angio-MR-CT imaging solutions, as well as surgical mobile c-arms in the Asia Pacific Region (ASEAN/ Japan/ Korea/ India/ Australia & New Zealand), through targeted marketing activities and artifacts, presentations at renowned international conferences and the cultivation of a wide network of influential clinical experts and KOLs.
- Establishing the awareness, understanding and need for intra-operative imaging and guidance in the fields of neurosurgery, spine surgery, orthopedic surgery, cardiac, vascular and thoracic surgery, as well as minimally invasive hybrid procedures.
- Creating and communicating the business case for hybrid operating rooms in Asia Pacific.
- Recruiting, onboarding and initiation of new team members into the complex theme of image-guided surgery, and empowerment of sales representatives to defend the Siemens portfolio and engage with surgeons to drive funnel growth

positions.title: Department Manager
positions.description:
Innovation Department - Advanced Therapies (AT) Business Area

I headed the AT Innovation Department in Japan and managed a team of research collaboration managers with full administrative, task-related and developmental responsibility. Our team conceived and conducted clinical research studies with the best national university hospitals, medical centers and private medical schools in Japan, to assess and validate new technologies in the field of image-guided therapies (including interventional neuro-radiology, oncology, and cardiology, neurosurgery, spine surgery, cardiac & vascular surgery and Hybrid OR imaging).

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description:
Led a team of research collaboration managers in Japan to deploy, test and evaluate software prototypes in the fields of interventional radiology and neuroradiology, interventional cardiology, cardiac and vascular surgery, as well as neuro and spine surgery.
Supported the deployment  and marketing of the Siemens Healthineers PURE® platform in Japan and in the world through the creation of unique clinical marketing materials and peer-reviewed publications, and the development of strong relationships with KOLs.

positions.title: Collaboration Manager
positions.description:
Managed technology validation projects in:
- Germany (Frankfurt, Nuremberg, Erlangen amd Munich)
- Asia Pacific Cluster, including National University Hospital of Singapore, Singapore General Hospital, and University of Malaya in Malaysia
- South-west Europe, including Switzerland (CHU Geneve), Belgium (Leuven University Hospital), Cardio-Thoracic Center of Monaco, and France (IHU Strasbourg, Paris-Quincy Hospital, CHU Bordeaux)
